svg.title: Sixteen enterprise screen archetypes — taste-neutral structural atlas
svg.desc: Sixteen fundamentally different enterprise software screen archetypes in monochrome: record form, kanban, calendar, map, flow designer, conversation, document editor, media gallery, timeline feed, wizard, inbox triage, floor plan, faceted search, comparison, approval chain, action console. Generic Lorem ipsum content only. No color, brand, or domain assumptions.
svg.text: Not everything is a table, a Gantt, or a board. Sixteen distinct control-surface families; each still carries the full interaction contract: primary action, context actions, manipulation, disclosure, reversibility, states, keyboard path.
Monochrome by design · sans-serif only · generic placeholder content · line weight and dash patterns encode state · no domain, brand, or color decisions

delegation path is explicit, not hidden
states: pending · approved · rejected · delegated · escalated · expired

svg.text: Form · Board · Calendar · Map · Flow · Chat · Document · Gallery · Feed · Wizard · Inbox · Plan · Search · Diff · Chain · Console — each carries primary action, context actions, manipulation, disclosure, reversibility, states, and keyboard parity. None assumes another's layout.
